goal: Blade SSH inference readiness sweep for Phoebus and WhoArt
body: Dave wants a live readiness sweep from Blade. From blade1tb, SSH/message Phoebus and WhoArt using the existing NouGen SSH/NouGenMsg paths and verify whether each lane is ready for inference right now. Check at minimum: host reachable, inference service/process reachable, resident/local model readiness if applicable, provider/free-lane reachability relevant to that node, and whether either lane is blocked by quota/auth/resource pressure. Do not mutate configs just to make a probe pass. Relay the measured result back with per-node status (READY / DEGRADED / NOT READY), evidence, latency where easy to capture, and the safest immediate routing recommendation for coach-mode work. If one host cannot be reached, report that explicitly rather than inferring. This is a probe/coordination leg, not permission to restart or reconfigure anything.
